summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing a board resolution on August 7, 2026 to pay a quarterly cash dividend of KRW 2,000 per share, implying a 0.6% yield based on the prior week's average closing price. Total dividend amounts to KRW 151,241,558,000. Record date is August 24, 2026, with payment on September 7, 2026. The company states its shareholder return target of 35-40% of adjusted net income attributable to controlling interests, assessed against annual performance. This is a routine periodic dividend declaration rather than a special one-off capital return event.
